premises.text: Shoppers cannot know how clothes fit online when items are shown only on standard models
premises.evidence_span: Clothes are shown on standard models, which are slim or tall, unlike real people

premises.text: Two questions about a brand and size that already fit generate a customizable personal model for try-on
premises.evidence_span: What brand fits her well right now? And what size in that brand fits her well? Boom, our model is ready

premises.text: True-to-size 3D visualization lets shoppers compare sizes and assemble full outfits in a fitting/styling room
premises.evidence_span: This is true to size. That means she can try on each sizes one by one and really see how each size would fit

premises.text: Designers' collections are digitized at scale and offered to retailers via API without upfront retailer cost
premises.evidence_span: Once they are digitized, we offer this collection to the retailers who carry these designers using our API

premises.text: Retailers pay as they go for sales lift, fewer returns, and consumer size/style analytics
premises.evidence_span: They pay us as they go. They get increased sales, reduced returns, and they get access to this amazing data, the analytics

value.text: Fix online fashion personalization so shoppers can try before committing
value.evidence_span: You have to really try it out before committing. And there is no way to try either of those online until now, at least for clothes

secondary_value.text: Move remaining offline fashion market online
secondary_value.evidence_span: this is how we're going to get the remaining 90% of fashion market online

causal_links.evidence_span: What's missing in online fashion shopping is personalization
What if you can create your own model and try on clothes on that model?
We work with fashion designers and digitize their collection
They get increased sales, reduced returns

notes: Split digitization supply vs retailer pay-as-you-go as separately revisable (API supply can work under different pricing). Holy Grail mass customization kept as secondary/vision-adjacent outcome phrasing. Company name spelling Fitiket/Fitikit left as in transcript.
